title: Appending a value to a segment
statement: Let $\mu:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Z}$, let $a\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $l$ be a finite list of natural numbers such that $\mu(a+i)$ equals the integer represented by $l_i$ for every $i<|l|$. For any natural number $x$, change $\mu$ at the single index $a+|l|$ to the integer represented by $x$. The resulting function agrees with the list obtained by appending $x$ to $l$ at every index of the segment starting at $a$.
hypotheses_covered: A list l of natural numbers
